RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: Not reliably quantifiable from these facts

An all-male panel is worth noting as a process concern, but does not itself establish sex discrimination. Your qualifications warrant a clear explanation; the announcement may omit relevant experience, and consultation or leadership skills may have carried more weight.

Follow up in writing, asking for the selection criteria, weighting, assessment of your application, and review procedure. You can neutrally ask how the municipality ensures balanced panels and guards against bias.

Stronger warning signs include inconsistent criteria, sex-related comments, departures from recruitment policy, or a pattern of unequal treatment. Two weeks’ silence alone proves little. Check local complaint deadlines now; awaiting an explanation may not pause them.
